sn45.76:1.1: -yad idaṃ yonisomanasikārasampadā || || Yonisomanasikārasampamassetam bhikkhave- || pe () || -maggam bahulīkaroti || || Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti || la (pe) || sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti rāgavinayapariyosānaṃ dosa- mohavinayapariyosānaṃ || || Evaṃ kho bhikkhave yonisomanasikārasampanno ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bhāveti ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bahulīkarotī ti || || {Ekadhammapeyyālaṃ} || ||
